#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：亲眼看到假服务器的「启动—服务—自清理」闭环。
2. **操作步骤**：运行只依赖文件服务器的单个测试，并用 `-v` 观察输出：
   ```bash
   go test -v -run 'TestDownloader_CreateDirectBatch$' ./pkg/download/
   ```
   然后运行 `TestDownloader_Resolve`（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L241-L272](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L241-L272)），它在 `StartTestCustomServer` 上请求 `disposition`、`gbk-encoded` 等端点。
3. **需要观察的现象**：测试期间工作目录出现 `build.data`（约 200MB）与下载产物，测试结束后二者均被 `Close()` 删除；`-v` 下每个子测试名（表驱动的 `name` 字段）逐条打印。
4. **预期结果**：全部 PASS，目录干净。若中途 Ctrl+C 强杀，残留的 `build.data` 需要手动删除——这正是 `Close()` 承担清理职责的原因。
5. 以上命令为标准 `go test` 用法，可本地直接验证。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `StartTestFailThenRecoverServer` 特意用 416 而不是 500 来制造「可计数的失败」？
**答案**：u5-l3 讲过 HTTP Fetcher 的重试规则——5xx 与 429 豁免于失败计数（会无限重试），而 416 会计入失败上限。要测试「失败 N 次后 `Start()` 重试成功」，必须用会被计数的错误码，否则重试永远不会停止、测试永不返回。

**练习 2**：`rangeFileHandle` 的 `modifyEnd` 参数解决了什么测试难题？
**答案**：让服务器「合法地违反协议」——响应头声称 `Content-Range: 0-100/…` 却实际多写 50 字节。不修改 `Content-Length` 只多给数据，正好构造出「响应体比声明长」的违规样本，用来验证客户端会拒绝而非默默截断。

**练习 3**：`AssertResourceEqual` 为什么要先把 `got.Files[0].Ctime` 置 nil 再比较？
**答案**：`Ctime` 是 Resolve 时刻的当前时间，每次运行都不同；不剥离的话 `reflect.DeepEqual` 必然失败。这是「剥离不稳定字段后再深比较」的常见手法。

### 4.2 批量与分组任务测试：测试替身与新测试精读

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

假 HTTP 服务器替的是**网络**，但很多下载器行为（排队、分组、删除恢复、竞态）根本不需要走网络——它们需要一个**假协议**。`generationTestManager` 就是注册进 Downloader 的最小 FetcherManager（u3-l4 的 `mock://` 协议正是参考它实现的）。本轮提交（1e36599）在 `pkg/download/downloader_test.go` 新增了 28 个测试函数、约 1100 行，全部建立在这套替身之上，覆盖 u4-l6 讲过的 TaskGroup 分组与 `CreateDirectBatchWithResult` 批量语义。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

分组批量测试的三层替身：

```text
第一层：generationTestManager（假协议）
  ├─ holdOpen=true   → Start() 后任务永远停在 running，便于断言队列
  ├─ resolveStarted/resolveRelease、pauseStarted/pauseRelease
  │     → 用通道把 Resolve/Pause 精确卡住，制造竞态窗口
  └─ starts/pauses 原子计数器 → 断言 Start/Pause 被调了几次

第二层：taskGroupTestStorage（存储装饰器）
  ├─ 嵌入真实 Storage，仅拦截 Put/Delete
  ├─ beforePut(task) 钩子 → 记录首次落盘 / 注入子任务写失败
  └─ failGroupPut / failGroupDelete → 让 task_group 桶读写失败

第三层：groupFailureConcurrentDeleteStorage（并发卡点装饰器）
  └─ Delete 命中 blockedID 时 close(entered) 并阻塞等 release
        → 测试主协程据此在「删除进行到一半」时发起第二个操作
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**① `generationTestManager`/`generationTestFetcher`：内存协议**。管理器只按 `generation://` 前缀匹配（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L110-L126](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L110-L126)）；Fetcher 的 `Resolve` 返回 1 字节单文件资源、`Start` 在 `holdOpen=false` 时立刻向 `done` 通道发 nil（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L128-L161](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L128-L161)）。配套的 `recoveryTestManager` 补上 `Store`/`Restore`，专门服务断点恢复类测试（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L191-L217](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L191-L217)）。

**② 分组测试脚手架**。`newTaskGroupDownloader` 一步造出「单协议 + 内存存储 + holdOpen」的 Downloader，并直接改写私有字段 `d.cfg.MaxRunning`（白盒优势），见 [pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4048-L4060](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4048-L4060)；`taskGroupBatch` 生成 `Group:true, GroupName:"folder"` 加 N 个 `generation://file/i` 成员的批量请求（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4062-L4068](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4062-L4068)）。

**③ 存储装饰器**。`taskGroupTestStorage` 嵌入 `Storage` 接口，按桶名拦截：`failGroupPut` 让 `task_group` 桶写入失败，`beforePut` 让普通任务落盘前注入错误（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4161-L4184](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4161-L4184)）。有了它，`TestDownloader_TaskGroupPartialFailureAndFirstSave` 才能让 3 个成员中间那个写盘失败、验证「部分成功」——批量为 3 只建成 2 个，且**首次落盘就带 ParentID**（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4186-L4224](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4186-L4224)）。

**④ 分组元数据与重启恢复**。`TestDownloader_TaskGroupMetadataAndRestore` 用真 `BoltStorage` 验证三件事：组不是任务（`GetTask(parentID) == nil`）；成员任务的 JSON 序列化含 `"group":` 但不含 `"type":`（组不会混进任务列表）；`Close()` 后重开同目录，`task.group` 指针被 Setup 重新挂接、删除组 ID 连带清空 `d.groups`（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4070-L4110](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4070-L4110)）。这正对应 u4-l6 讲的「ParentID 落盘为权威、group 指针为运行时缓存」双轨制。

**⑤ 队列与按组操作**。`TestDownloader_TaskGroupQueue` 以 `MaxRunning=5` 提交 6 成员批（叠加 0/2 个既有任务），断言 `running=5-existing`、`waiting=1+existing`；再按「组 ID + 成员 ID」暂停，验证全部成员进入 pause 且 `d.waitTasks` 清空、`expandGroupTaskIDs` 去重后仍为 6（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4112-L4159](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4112-L4159)）。

**⑥ 删除失败的持久化恢复**（u4-l4 rebuild 讲义的核心机制的测试证据）：

- `TestDownloader_TaskGroupDeletePersistence`：删除成员失败后，任务**必须仍在内存**且**必须仍在 `bucketTask` 桶里**——测试直接 `storage.Get(bucketTask, …)` 验证落盘恢复（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4367-L4385](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4367-L4385)）。
- `TestDownloader_TaskGroupConcurrentDelete`：用 `entered`/`release` 通道把成员 A 的删除卡在存储层，此刻删掉成员 B——断言组元数据**不被并发清理误删**（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4387-L4426](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4387-L4426)）。
- `TestDownloader_TaskGroupDeleteFailureRestoresQueue`：删除一个 wait 态成员失败后，它必须回到 `d.waitTasks` 队列；随后删掉 running 成员，被保留者应被唤醒进入 running（用共享辅助 `waitForTaskStatus` 轮询断言，[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4479-L4501](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4479-L4501)；该辅助定义于 [pkg/download/extension_test.go:L2042-L2063](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/extension_test.go#L2042-L2063)，done 态还要等 `watchedTasks` 登记清除，避免竞态误判）。

**⑦ 批量三规则的直接验证**。u4-l6 讲过「rid 优先、成员 opts 整体替换、部分成功」，`TestDownloader_BatchMixedResolvedAndDirect` 把它们压进一个批次：`Rid:"missing"`（跳过）、`Rid+Req 并存`（rid 赢，URL 是 `unsupported://` 仍按已解析资源建任务）+ `SelectFiles:[1]`（选择保留）、纯 `Req` 直建、空成员（跳过）；再断言成功的 rid 已从 `fetcherCache` 消费、失败的 rid 不阻断后续合法成员（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4801-L4842](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4801-L4842)）。全败路径由 `TestDownloader_BatchAllFailedAndResolvedSelection` 覆盖：报错、rid **不被**消费、空组与预留目录全部回收（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4844-L4869](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4844-L4869)）；「启动失败但已落盘的任务算成功且保留成员资格」由 `TestDownloader_BatchStartFailureKeepsCreatedTasks` 覆盖（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4871-L4894](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4871-L4894)）。

**⑧ 上层测试如何接力**。三层测试各自换一种「驱动方式」验证同一批语义：

- **服务层**（不启 HTTP 服务器）：`TestBatchResolvedAndDirectCreation` 用泛型辅助 `serviceTestRequest` 直接调 `Service.JSON`，循环 `grouped=false/true` 断言响应字段——非分组只有 `taskIds`、分组多出 `parentId`；全败批次返回错误信封（[pkg/api/service_test.go:L271-L331](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/api/service_test.go#L271-L331)，辅助在 [L71-L90](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/api/service_test.go#L71-L90)）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `newTaskGroupDownloader` 要把 `holdOpen` 设为 true？如果设为 false，`TestDownloader_TaskGroupQueue` 的哪个断言会失效？
**答案**：`holdOpen=true` 让 `Start()` 不向 `done` 通道发结果，任务停留在 running。若为 false，先抢到运行位的成员会瞬间完成、腾出空位，`running=5-existing / waiting=1+existing` 的精确计数就会漂移——测试会变成「看谁跑得快」的竞态赌局。

**练习 2**：`taskGroupTestStorage` 与 `groupFailureConcurrentDeleteStorage` 都是存储装饰器，为何还需要第二种？
**答案**：前者只能让 Put/Delete **确定性地失败**；后者要在「删除执行到一半」的瞬间让另一个操作插进来，这需要 `close(entered)` 通知主协程「我已进入临界区」、`<-release` 等待放行——用通道把时序变成测试可精确控制的确定性事件，而不是靠 sleep 撞运气。

**练习 3**：`TestDownloader_BatchMixedResolvedAndDirect` 里 `Rid` 与 `Req` 同时存在且 `Req.URL` 是 `unsupported://`，为什么任务还能建成？
**答案**：批量规则「rid 优先」——有有效 rid 时直接消费 `fetcherCache` 里已解析好的 Fetcher，`Req` 仅作为兜底字段被忽略，因此其 URL 是否可路由无关紧要。这正是 u2-l1/u4-l6 讲过的 rid 优先语义的测试证据。

### 4.3 extmock 扩展模拟服务

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

扩展是跑在 goja/WebView 里的 JavaScript，故障常出在「脚本在这台机器的浏览器环境里行为不对」。为此项目提供了一个**手动调试 CLI**——`cmd/extmock`，它不参与 CI，是给扩展开发者用的：不启动 Flutter UI，直接在 Go 侧安装一个本地扩展文件夹、驱动 Resolve/下载、甚至对扩展引擎执行任意 JS。它是 u9 系列讲义的上手工具，也是「测试金字塔」之外的探索性工具。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
extmock resolve ./ext-dir https://example.com/file
  ├─ newExtMockDownloader：NewDownloader(MemStorage + WebViewProvider) + Setup
  ├─ InstallExtensionByFolder(dev=true)
  ├─ 可选 UpdateExtensionSettings（-setting k=v）
  ├─ d.Resolve(&base.Request{URL, Labels})
  └─ 打印 ResolveResult JSON

extmock download ./ext-dir <url> <output-dir>
  ├─ 同上解析 → 得到 Resource 文件列表
  ├─ 逐文件 d.CreateDirect(file.Req, opts)   ← 扩展产出的每文件请求
  ├─ taskTerminalWaiter 轮询 GetTask 至 done/error（5 分钟超时）
  └─ 打印 {resolve, outputDir, files[{name,path,taskId,status,size}]} 摘要

extmock eval -e "new Blob(['hello']).size"
  └─ NewExtensionEngine + runtime.Eval / EvalFile → 打印 JS 值
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

- 入口分派 `resolve`/`download`/`eval` 三个子命令，见 [cmd/extmock/main.go:L53-L87](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/cmd/extmock/main.go#L53-L87)；usage 里给出全部旗标与示例（[cmd/extmock/main.go:L89-L114](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/cmd/extmock/main.go#L89-L114)）。
- `runResolve`：安装 dev 扩展 → 注入设置 → `d.Resolve` 并打印结果，支持 `-label`/`-setting` 反复追加（[cmd/extmock/main.go:L116-L174](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/cmd/extmock/main.go#L116-L174)）。

### 4.4 CI 命令矩阵与覆盖率采集

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

[.github/workflows/test.yml](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml) 是全部质量闸门。它由一个核心测试作业（含覆盖率上传）、两个 Flutter 侧测试作业、一个三 OS webview 集成矩阵和四个构建检查作业组成；PR 与 push 到 main 都只在 `bind/cmd/internal/pkg/ui` 等路径变化时触发（[.github/workflows/test.yml:L3-L28](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L3-L28)），避免文档改动浪费流水线。工具链版本固定为 Go 1.25.4 / Flutter 3.41.6（[L30-L32](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L30-L32)，与 [go.mod:L3](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/go.mod#L3) 对齐）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

核心测试作业的命令链（[.github/workflows/test.yml:L48-L71](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L48-L71)）：

```bash
# 1. 选包：排除 bind/（cgo 绑定无测试）与 cmd/*，但保留 cmd/web（有 flags_test）
PACKAGES=$(go list ./... | awk '!/\/bind\// && (!/\/cmd\// || /\/cmd\/web$/)')
# 2. 跑测：CGO 开启（bbolt/webview 需要）+ 虚拟显示 + webview 标签 + 跨包覆盖率
env CGO_ENABLED=1 xvfb-run -a go test -tags webview -v \
  -coverpkg=$PACKAGES -covermode=count -coverprofile=coverage.txt $PACKAGES
# 3. 过滤 main.go 行（入口函数拉低覆盖率）后上传 codecov
grep -v "main.go" coverage.txt > coverage_filtered.txt || true
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

- **包选择 awk**：一条表达式完成「排除法 + 例外」，注释明确说明保留 `cmd/web` 是为了它的 flags 测试（[.github/workflows/test.yml:L60-L64](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L60-L64)）。
- **`-tags webview` + `xvfb-run`**：让带 `//go:build cgo && webview` 门禁的集成测试（如 [internal/webview/goprovider/provider_integration_test.go:L1-L21](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/internal/webview/goprovider/provider_integration_test.go#L1-L21)，跑 Provider 契约/Profile/事件三组合同测试）参与编译，并在无显示器的 Linux 上给 GTK 事件循环一个虚拟 X server。
- **webview 集成矩阵**（[.github/workflows/test.yml:L115-L202](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L115-L202)）：Windows/Linux/macOS 三系统策略各不相同——Linux 先 `go test -c` 编出测试二进制再以 `-test.count=5` 在**同一 GTK 事件循环**上重复跑，专捕「引擎销毁后残留回调」；Windows `-count=3` 捕浏览器关闭竞态；macOS 最重：真编 `libgopeed.dylib`、`flutter run --machine` 拉起完整应用并监听 `app.started` 事件，再让 rpcprovider 测试通过 unix socket 连进这个活应用（[L158-L202](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L158-L202)）。
- **共享规则表双端跑**：`test-flutter-category` 作业跑 `ui/flutter/test/api/downloader_config_test.dart`，注释点明分类规则表由设置界面与后端共同读取，Go 侧已由主测试作业覆盖、Dart 侧由本作业覆盖（[.github/workflows/test.yml:L72-L88](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L72-L88)）。
- **构建检查**：desktop 五 OS 矩阵（含 Windows ARM64 与 Ubuntu ARM）、mobile（macOS 出 iOS、Linux 出 Android）、web（Flutter Web 产物嵌入 `cmd/web/dist` 后 `go build -tags nosqlite,web`）、docker，全部 `needs: [test]` 串联（[.github/workflows/test.yml:L204-L347](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L204-L347)）。lint 作业目前整段注释掉（[L35-L47](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/.github/workflows/test.yml#L35-L47)）。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：在本地复现 CI 的选包与测试命令。
2. **操作步骤**：
   ```bash
   # 只看 CI 会测试哪些包（不动任何东西）
   go list ./... | awk '!/\/bind\// && (!/\/cmd\// || /\/cmd\/web$/)'
   # 无 GTK 依赖时的简化版（去掉 webview 标签与 xvfb；CGO 保留，bbolt 需要）
   go test ./pkg/download/... ./pkg/api/... ./pkg/rest/...
   ```
3. **需要观察的现象**：第一条命令输出的包列表里没有 `bind/…`、`cmd/gopeed`，但有 `cmd/web`；测试会真实下载（假服务器）并打印各测试结果。
4. **预期结果**：包列表符合排除规则；测试全绿。Linux 上若已安装 `libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev xvfb`，则可完整复现 CI 命令（含 `-tags webview` 与 `xvfb-run`）；未安装时带 webview 标签的编译会失败，属预期。
5. `go list`/`go test` 为标准命令，可本地直接验证；完整 CI 等价命令待本地验证（取决于本机 GUI 依赖）。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 CI 用 `-coverpkg=$PACKAGES` 指定全部包，而不是让每个包只统计自己的覆盖率？
**答案**：`-coverpkg` 把指定包的插桩打进**被测进程**，跨包测试（如 `pkg/rest` 的测试穿过 api 层直达 download 层）也能给沿途代码记覆盖率，总量远大于各包自测之和，得到的 coverage.txt 才真实反映整条调用链的覆盖情况。

**练习 2**：Linux webview 作业为什么要 `go test -c` 手动编二进制、再 `-test.count=5` 重复执行？
**答案**：注释写明目标是「在同一 GTK 事件循环上重复，捕获引擎销毁后仍在排队的回调」。`-count=5` 让同一进程内五轮测试共享进程级状态（GTK 主循环、全局注册表），单次运行看似正常的销毁时序 bug 在重复后才会暴露；先 `-c` 是为了带上与主测试一致的 `-coverpkg` 插桩。

**练习 3**：如果只想在本地快速验证自己改动的 `pkg/download` 代码没破坏分组功能，最小命令是什么？
**答案**：`go test -run 'TestDownloader_TaskGroup|TestDownloader_Batch' ./pkg/download/`——正则同时匹配两组测试，跳过耗时的真实 HTTP 下载用例（那些用例生成 200MB 测试文件），几十秒内出结果。

## 5. 综合实践

**为 u3-l4 的自定义 `mock://` 协议补一组单元测试**，把本讲三层替身手法全部用一遍。在 `pkg/download/` 下新建 `mock_protocol_test.go`（示例代码，仅供练习）：

1. **Resolve 分支**：仿照 `generationTestFetcher`（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L128-L161](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L128-L161)），构造 `mock://ok` 与 `mock://bad` 两种 URL，断言前者 Resolve 成功返回单文件资源、后者返回错误且 Task 不产生。
2. **断点续传分支**：仿照 `recoveryTestManager`（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L191-L217](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L191-L217)）为协议实现 Store/Restore，写出「下载→暂停→Close→新 Downloader 重开同目录→Continue→完成」的恢复测试，参考 `TestDownloader_StoreAndRestore`（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L1195](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L1195)）的骨架。
3. **错误分支**：给 Fetcher 加一个 `done <- err` 的出错开关，断言任务进入 error 态且 `Wait()` 的错误被 watch 循环正确写回 `task.Error`。
4. **验证**：`go test -run 'TestMockProtocol' -v ./pkg/download/`，三条路径全绿即完成。若你的 u3-l4 实现与本仓库测试脚手架字段有出入，以让测试通过为准调整练习代码（不要改产品源码）。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **`internal/test` 假服务器家族**：一台服务器模拟一种线上故障（一次性 URL、忽略 Range、过期重定向、Cookie 失效、连接数限制、多给数据……），`rangeFileHandle` 是可注入违规行为的 Range 处理核心，200MB 随机数据 + 随机端口 + 自动清理保证隔离与确定性。
- **下载器级测试靠内存协议**：`generationTestManager`（holdOpen 卡运行态、通道卡竞态点、原子计数）+ 存储装饰器（按桶注入失败）+ 并发卡点装饰器（entered/release 通道），让最难的竞态与故障恢复变成确定性断言。
- **本轮新增约 1100 行批量/分组测试**直接为 u4-l4/u4-l6 的语义背书：组不是任务、首次落盘即带 ParentID、部分成功、rid 优先且失败不消费、删除失败回写 bucketTask 并恢复队列、并发清理不误删组元数据。
- **三层驱动共享同一套实现**：服务层 `Service.JSON` 进程内调用（无 HTTP）、REST 层真实往返（Mem/Bolt 双存储矩阵）、分类层纯单测表驱动——呼应 u8-l1「handler 不接触网络对象」的设计红利。
- **extmock 是探索工具不是测试**：不进 CI，供扩展开发者命令行驱动 Resolve/下载/eval JS，`go`/`rpc` 两种 WebView provider 分别适配本机与外部宿主。
- **CI 命令矩阵**：排除法选包 + `-tags webview` + `xvfb-run` + 跨包 `-coverpkg` 覆盖率 + codecov；webview 集成在三 OS 上用三种策略重复执行捕销毁竞态；四个构建检查作业在测试通过后串联。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- 下一讲 **u11-l2 并发控制与优雅关闭**：本讲多次出现的 `waitForTaskStatus`、`runGeneration`、通道卡点，都将在锁清单与 Close 时序的框架下得到统一解释。

- 若对 webview 集成感兴趣，读 [internal/webview/integrationtest/contract.go](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/1e36599d52bc50c3aea479d348f3e9ccd43a448e/internal/webview/integrationtest/contract.go) 看三种 provider 如何用同一份「合同测试」约束行为一致。

## 总目标

根据 stdin 中给出的讲义规格，生成一篇适合学习手册的 Markdown 讲义。

讲义必须：

1. 全部使用中文。
2. 从零开始解释，不默认读者已经熟悉项目。
3. 结合真实源码讲解。
4. 包含可操作的代码实践任务。
5. 结构清晰，适合长期维护。
6. 对关键源码给出永久链接和行号。
7. 不编造不存在的代码、命令、接口或行为。

---

## 工作流程

生成讲义前，请按顺序完成：

1. 阅读 stdin 中的讲义规格。
2. 阅读 `source_files` 中列出的关键源码。
3. 如果源码不足，用 `Grep` / `Glob` 补充查找相关入口、测试、示例和调用链。
4. 确认本讲义的最小模块。
5. 根据 action 执行：

   - `new`：从零创建该讲义。
   - `rebuild`：从零重建该讲义。
   - `update`：先读取已有讲义，再结合 diff 更新。
   - `keep`：如果被调用，通常不需要编辑文件，只做简短说明。

---

## update 模式规则

当 action 为 `update` 时：

1. 先 `Read` 当前已有的讲义文件。
2. 使用 `git diff previous_head..current_head` 查看相关代码变化。
3. 更新已经失效的源码说明。
4. 刷新所有永久链接中的 head 和行号。
5. 保留仍然正确的内容。
6. 新增必要解释和实践步骤。
7. 如果核心流程已经变化，可以重写受影响章节。

---

## 讲义标准结构

每篇讲义必须使用下面的结构。

```md
# 讲义标题

## 1. 本讲目标

说明读者学完后应该掌握什么。

## 2. 前置知识

用通俗语言解释本讲需要的基础概念。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

列出本讲涉及的关键文件，并说明每个文件的作用。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

按最小模块拆分。

每个最小模块都必须包含：

### 4.x 模块名称

#### 4.x.1 概念说明

解释这个模块是什么、解决什么问题、为什么需要它。

#### 4.x.2 核心流程

用列表、流程图式文字或伪代码描述执行过程。

如涉及算法、协议、并发、缓存、调度、状态机等，可以补充必要数学或原理说明。

数学公式使用：

- 行内：\( ... \)
- 独立公式：\[ ... \]

不要使用 `$...$`。

#### 4.x.3 源码精读

引用真实项目代码。

每个关键代码点都要给出永久链接，格式为：

[文件路径:L起始-L结束](<permalink_base>/<相对路径>#L起始-L结束)

链接旁边必须用中文说明这段代码做了什么。

#### 4.x.4 代码实践

给出一个可操作的小实践，例如：

- 运行一个示例。
- 阅读一个测试。
- 修改一个配置。
- 添加一行日志。
- 改一个参数观察行为。
- 编写一个最小调用示例。
- 跟踪一条调用链。

实践步骤要包含：

1. 实践目标。
2. 操作步骤。
3. 需要观察的现象。
4. 预期结果。
5. 如果无法确定运行结果，明确写「待本地验证」。

不要假装已经运行过命令。

#### 4.x.5 小练习与答案

给出 2 到 3 个练习题，并直接给出参考答案。
```

---

## 讲义结尾必须包含

```md
## 5. 综合实践

设计一个贯穿本讲主要内容的小任务，帮助读者把知识串起来。

## 6. 本讲小结

用 3 到 6 条 bullet 总结本讲。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

说明下一讲应该学习什么，或者建议读者继续阅读哪些源码。
```

---

## 代码实践要求

每篇讲义至少包含一个完整代码实践。

实践优先从以下位置寻找依据：

- README
- examples
- tests
- scripts
- package scripts
- Makefile
- CI 配置
- 项目已有 demo

如果找不到可运行示例，也必须提供「源码阅读型实践」，例如：

- 跟踪函数调用链。
- 根据测试断言理解行为。
- 修改局部参数并说明应该观察什么。
- 给关键函数添加日志。
- 阅读配置加载过程并画出流程。

---

## 源码引用要求

- 只引用实际存在的文件。
- 行号必须准确。
- 永久链接必须使用当前 HEAD。
- 如果无法确认行号，不要编造，标注「待确认」。
- 示例代码如果不是项目原有代码，必须明确标注为「示例代码」。

---

## 写作风格

- 中文。
- 深入浅出。
- 先讲直觉，再讲源码。
- 多使用标题、列表、表格和伪代码。
- 不要写空泛总结。
- 不要堆砌大段源码。
- 代码片段要短，只保留关键部分。
- 对初学者不熟悉的术语要解释。

---

## 输出与写入规则

- 只写 stdin 指定的文件。
- 文件路径必须是 `<项目名>-tutorial/<filename>`。
- 不要写其他文件。
- 不要修改源码。
- 完成后，用一句话总结本讲义覆盖了哪些最小模块。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

schema.name: Glob
schema.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

schema.name: Grep
schema.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

# AGENTS.md

This document defines the implementation standards for this Flutter project.

## 1) Product Scope

- This is a cross-platform app that must support both desktop and mobile.
- Every page must use responsive layouts and behave correctly across:
  - Mobile phone sizes
  - Tablet sizes
  - Desktop window sizes, including resizable windows
- Desktop is currently the primary design target, but the architecture must remain ready for future mobile-specific variants.

## 2) Required Project Structure

Use the following structure as the baseline and do not introduce alternative top-level patterns:

```text
lib/
├── main.dart
├── app/
│   ├── app.dart
│   ├── router/
│   │   ├── app_router.dart
│   │   └── shells/
│   │       └── main_shell.dart
│   └── application/
│       └── locale_controller.dart
├── core/
│   ├── network/
│   ├── error/
│   └── utils/
├── shared/
│   └── widgets/
├── features/
│   ├── auth/
│   ├── tasks/
│   ├── extensions/
│   └── settings/
└── l10n/
    ├── app_en.arb
    ├── app_zh.arb
    └── app_zh_TW.arb
```

## 2.1) Core Tech Stack

Use the following as the baseline stack for this project:

- `flutter_riverpod`
- `go_router`
- `flutter_localizations`
- `dio`
- `window_manager`
- `tray_manager`
- `desktop_multi_window`
- `shadcn_flutter`

Guidelines:

- Do not introduce alternative frameworks for the same responsibility unless explicitly approved.
- Keep app-level state aligned with Riverpod patterns when new shared state is introduced.
- Keep navigation centralized in `lib/app/router/`.
- Keep network access built on top of Dio abstractions in `lib/core/network/`.
- Keep desktop window, tray, and multi-window logic encapsulated and platform-guarded.
- `shadcn_flutter` is the default product UI system for app surfaces and controls.

## 3) UI Design Rules

- Maintain a consistent visual language across desktop and mobile.
- Define and reuse design tokens for color, spacing, radius, typography, elevation, and motion.
- Avoid hard-coded one-off styles in page files; prefer centralized tokens and shared primitives.
- Preserve accessibility and usable contrast in both light and dark themes.
- Respect platform ergonomics:
  - Mobile: larger tap areas, reduced density, simpler layouts
  - Desktop: hover states, richer density, resize-aware layouts, window-aware composition

## 3.1) Theme Extension Rules

- Custom app colors must be exposed through Flutter `ThemeExtension`, not scattered as widget-local hard-coded values.
- Keep the app's semantic color tokens centralized in the shared theme layer under `lib/shared/theme/`.
- Widgets should read custom colors via shared theme accessors such as `AppPalette.of(context)` or `Theme.of(context).extension<...>()`, not by repeating raw hex values.
- Raw `Color(0x...)` values are allowed only inside the shared theme definition layer, platform interop code, or when a plugin API requires a direct color constant.
- When a new component needs a design-specific color, first promote it to a semantic theme token such as `taskCardHover`, `headerDivider`, or `captionButtonHover` instead of adding another local constant.
- If both `shadcn_flutter` theme data and Flutter `ThemeData` are used, keep them mapped from the same source-of-truth tokens so light and dark mode stay aligned.

## 3.2) Design Source of Truth

- When a screen or component exists under `design/`, Flutter must match its layout, spacing, hierarchy, and motion behavior before introducing local reinterpretation.
- Preserve the app's existing light and dark palette values as the canonical color source of truth even if the H5 prototype uses different colors.
- Do not copy H5 colors blindly. Rebuild structure and interaction fidelity using the Flutter theme tokens.

## 3.3) shadcn_flutter Rules

- Use `shadcn_flutter` as the default UI component library for product-facing surfaces.
- Use the `shadcn_flutter` documentation reference at:
  - [llms-full.txt](https://sunarya-thito.github.io/shadcn_flutter/llms-full.txt)
- Prefer `import 'package:shadcn_flutter/shadcn_flutter.dart';` as the primary UI import form.
- `shadcn_flutter` should have the highest import priority in product UI files. Keep it unaliased by default, and only add aliases to secondary packages when needed to avoid symbol conflicts or to clarify source ownership.
- Prefer `ShadcnApp` / `ShadcnApp.router` at the app shell level.
- Prefer `shadcn_flutter` controls such as buttons, inputs, tabs, dividers, and overlays over Material-style product UI widgets.
- Material may remain only where required for platform/plugin interop or Flutter internals, not as the default product design system.
- Product-facing interactive widgets must not use Flutter Material components such as `TextField`, `SnackBar`, `AlertDialog`, `showDialog`, `TextButton`, `ElevatedButton`, `OutlinedButton`, `IconButton`, `Drawer`, or similar Material UI controls when an equivalent `shadcn_flutter` primitive exists.
- A `material.dart` import is acceptable only for low-level primitives such as `Icons`, `Colors`, `ChangeNotifier`, geometry, painting, focus, text editing, or platform/plugin interop. It must not be used as a shortcut to build product UI controls.
- Tooltips are a documented exception to the Material-component restriction: always use the shared `AppTooltip` from `lib/shared/widgets/app_tooltip.dart`. It intentionally wraps Flutter's Material `Tooltip` because `shadcn_flutter`'s tooltip does not inherit the app's mixed Shadcn/Material theme consistently, which can produce a transparent-looking background and oversized text.
- Never instantiate either Flutter's `Tooltip` or `shadcn_flutter`'s `Tooltip` directly in feature/page code. Keep tooltip messages localized and route all product tooltip styling and behavior through `AppTooltip`.
- When auditing UI code, distinguish between:
  - acceptable Material foundation usage
  - forbidden Material product-component usage
- If a screen already uses `shadcn_flutter`, do not mix in Material product widgets for convenience. Replace them with `shadcn_flutter` equivalents or shared wrappers built on top of `shadcn_flutter`.

### 3.3.1 Text Input Rules

- All product-facing editable text controls must use the shared `AppTextField` from `lib/shared/widgets/app_text_field.dart`.
- This rule applies to every input variant, including search fields, login and password fields, URL fields, numeric fields, multiline editors, settings controls, dialog inputs, and feature-specific form fields.
- Do not instantiate Flutter Material `TextField` or `shadcn_flutter`'s `TextField` directly in feature or page code. Direct construction is allowed only while implementing or extending a shared input primitive, with the reason documented in that primitive.
- `AppTextField` owns the cross-platform text-selection menu policy. Android, iOS, desktop, and Web must all use Flutter's adaptive native context menu so long-press and right-click selection actions follow platform behavior without `shadcn_flutter`'s full-screen context-menu overlay.
- Do not use `shadcn_flutter`'s editable-text context menu on any platform.
- Feature and page code must not override `contextMenuBuilder`. Any exception must be implemented centrally in `AppTextField`, justified by a platform requirement, and covered by Android/iOS and desktop tests.
- Preserve existing field behavior when migrating to `AppTextField`, including controllers, focus nodes, input formatters, autofill hints, password visibility, read-only state, input features, keyboard actions, and multiline sizing.
- Prefer stable keys or `AppTextField` when locating app inputs in widget tests. Do not couple product tests to the exact runtime type of the underlying `shadcn_flutter` implementation.
- Changes to the shared input policy must include regression coverage for Android long-press behavior and desktop right-click behavior. Web builds must keep the same shared native-menu policy.

## 3.4) Desktop Design Metrics

Use the following desktop reference metrics unless a specific screen requires a documented exception:

- Reference window: `1024 x 768`
- Primary rail width: `78px` (reserves space for native macOS traffic lights)
- Secondary filter sidebar width: `256px`
- Main content header height: `80px`
- Window drag header height on Windows: `30px`
- Task row height: `72px`
- Standard control radius: `4px`
- Window / overlay radius: `12px`
- Spacing rhythm: `4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32`

## 3.5) Motion Rules

- Motion is part of the spec, not decoration.
- Recreate the design interactions when present in `design/`, including:
  - Progress shimmer / specular sweep
  - Indeterminate progress motion
  - Animated speed gauges / meters
  - Drawer slide-in transitions
  - Hover and selection transitions
  - Batch-mode reveal transitions
- Centralize durations, curves, and motion constants whenever motion becomes shared across multiple widgets.

## 4) Responsive Layout Rules

- All screens must be responsive by default.
- Never build a page for a single fixed size only.
- Use adaptive patterns such as:
  - `LayoutBuilder`
  - breakpoints
  - `Flexible` / `Expanded`
  - desktop and mobile variants when needed
- Verify every major page on at least:
  - small mobile width
  - medium / tablet width
  - desktop width

## 5) Component Decomposition Rules

### 5.1) Split aggressively into small files

- If a child widget is reusable or has an independent UI responsibility, move it to a separate file.
- Do not keep large page files with many inline private widgets if those sections can be extracted cleanly.
- Keep widgets focused and single-purpose.

### 5.2) Two levels of component abstraction

1. App-shared, non-business components
   - Place in `lib/shared/widgets/`
   - Examples: buttons, headers, chips, cards, window chrome, reusable form controls
   - Must stay business-agnostic and design-system aligned

2. Feature or page-specific components
   - Place close to usage inside the feature module
   - Recommended paths:
     - `lib/features/<feature>/presentation/pages/`
     - `lib/features/<feature>/presentation/widgets/`

### 5.3) Separation guidance

- Shared first when the component is used by multiple features or is purely design-system UI.
- Feature-local when the component is tightly coupled to one feature's state or interaction model.
- Promote from feature-local to shared only when reuse is real, not hypothetical.

### 5.4) Dual-platform component pattern

When mobile and desktop variants differ significantly, do not keep both branches inside one large widget file.

Required pattern:

```text
lib/features/<feature>/presentation/widgets/<component>/
├── <component>.dart
├── <component>_mobile.dart
└── <component>_desktop.dart
```

Rules:

- Only import the facade file from pages or sibling widgets.
- Keep business logic outside the mobile and desktop view files when possible.
- If a shared component also needs this split, apply the same pattern under `lib/shared/widgets/<component>/`.

## 6) Desktop Window and Chrome Rules

- Do not simulate OS switching inside the app UI.
- Adapt window chrome to the actual running platform:
  - macOS: prefer native system chrome behavior
  - Windows: use custom frameless chrome
  - Linux: prefer native behavior unless custom frameless support is explicitly verified as stable
- The desktop window header / chrome must be implemented as a reusable shared component so it can be reused by:
  - the main window
  - the create-task child window
  - future child windows
- Keep desktop window infrastructure in `lib/core/window/`.
- Keep reusable visual window header components under `lib/shared/widgets/window/` or an equivalent shared path.

## 6.1) Cross-Window Capability Rules

- Follow the mandatory architecture in [`docs/window-capability-rpc.md`](docs/window-capability-rpc.md) for all communication between the main window and desktop child windows.
- The main window is the sole owner of the Gopeed runtime, Gopeed API connection, and Hive database.
- Child windows must use `AppCapabilities`; they must not initialize Gopeed, open Hive, import `lib/api/api.dart`, or access `Database.instance`.
- Add new cross-window operations through shared `RpcMethod` descriptors and the central codec/registry. Do not add feature-specific MethodChannels or duplicate host/client serialization wrappers.
- Main-to-child state updates must use centrally declared events with complete state snapshots.

## 7) Page Implementation Standard

For each page:

- Keep the page entry widget in a page file.
- Move each meaningful sub-section into dedicated widget files.
- Keep business state and side effects outside pure presentational widgets where practical.
- Keep responsive logic explicit and readable.
- Reuse shared tokens and shared window/header primitives instead of rebuilding them locally.
- Desktop pages and desktop child windows must reserve `AppDesignTokens.windowHeaderHeight` at the top of their root content surface before the first visible content starts. This padding is owned by the page/window body itself, including create-task child windows, rather than being injected by a global shell.

## 8) Naming and Organization

- Use clear, intention-revealing names.
- Favor suffixes:
  - `...Page`
  - `...Section`
  - `...Card`
  - `...Tile`
  - `...Button`
  - `...Header`
- Avoid placeholder names such as `Widget1`, `TempView`, or `CommonBox`.

## 9) Localization and Text

- All user-facing natural-language strings must be localizable. This includes widget copy, validation and error messages, empty states, dialogs, tooltips, accessibility labels, tray menus, desktop notifications, Android foreground-service notifications, and child-window copy.
- `lib/l10n/app_en.arb` is the source template. Add each new message to every `lib/l10n/app_<locale>.arb` catalog, keeping the same key set in every locale. Prefer a base locale such as `app_zh.arb`; add a region-qualified catalog such as `app_zh_TW.arb` only when it has a distinct selectable translation.
- In widgets, read messages through `context.l10n`. In non-widget or background code, resolve the configured/system locale through the shared helpers in `lib/l10n/l10n.dart`; do not introduce a separate translation lookup mechanism.
- Translate message values only, and never rename variables such as `{count}` or `{name}`. In a message like `{count, plural, =1{1 file} other{{count} files}}`, translate the user-visible branch text while keeping `count`, `plural`, branch selectors such as `=1`/`other`, and the braces valid. Preserve the corresponding ARB placeholder metadata, and do not translate metadata keys prefixed with `@`.
- Prefer parameterized messages over string concatenation when word order can vary by language. Give placeholders explicit metadata and Dart types in the English ARB when appropriate.
- Do not edit generated `app_localizations*.dart` files. Regenerate them from ARB sources with `flutter gen-l10n`.
- Language names in the locale selector should remain native autonyms. Protocol names, product names, URLs, version strings, and dynamic data do not need translation unless they form part of natural-language copy.
- Design for longer translations and right-to-left locales: avoid fixed text widths, use flexible/wrapping layouts where needed, and do not encode direction with left/right-only assumptions.
- Do not hard-code production UI copy directly in widgets. Prototype-only text must be localized before the feature is considered complete.
- Before completing localization work, run from `ui/flutter`:

```sh
dart run ../../.github/workflows/scripts/check_l10n.dart
flutter gen-l10n
flutter analyze
flutter test
```

## 10) Quality Gate

Before merging major UI work:

- Verify desktop and mobile responsive behavior.
- Verify alignment and spacing consistency with shared tokens.
- Verify widget decomposition follows shared versus feature-local rules.
- Verify no obvious style duplication remains in page files where shared components are appropriate.
- Verify desktop window chrome behavior is correct for the target platform.
- Verify screens that exist in `design/` still match the intended layout and motion behavior.

- The main window is the sole owner of the Gopeed runtime, Gopeed API connection, and Hive database.
- Child windows must use `AppCapabilities`; they must not initialize Gopeed, open Hive, import `lib/api/api.dart`, or access `Database.instance`.
- Add new cross-window operations through shared `RpcMethod` descriptors and the central codec/registry. Do not add feature-specific MethodChannels or duplicate host/client serialization wrappers.
- Main-to-child state updates must use centrally declared events with complete state snapshots.

## 7) Page Implementation Standard

For each page:

- Keep the page entry widget in a page file.
- Move each meaningful sub-section into dedicated widget files.
- Keep business state and side effects outside pure presentational widgets where practical.
- Keep responsive logic explicit and readable.
- Reuse shared tokens and shared window/header primitives instead of rebuilding them locally.
- Desktop pages and desktop child windows must reserve `AppDesignTokens.windowHeaderHeight` at the top of their root content surface before the first visible content starts. This padding is owned by the page/window body itself, including create-task child windows, rather than being injected by a global shell.

## 8) Naming and Organization

- Use clear, intention-revealing names.
- Favor suffixes:
  - `...Page`
  - `...Section`
  - `...Card`
  - `...Tile`
  - `...Button`
  - `...Header`
- Avoid placeholder names such as `Widget1`, `TempView`, or `CommonBox`.

## 9) Localization and Text

- All user-facing natural-language strings must be localizable. This includes widget copy, validation and error messages, empty states, dialogs, tooltips, accessibility labels, tray menus, desktop notifications, Android foreground-service notifications, and child-window copy.
- `lib/l10n/app_en.arb` is the source template. Add each new message to every `lib/l10n/app_<locale>.arb` catalog, keeping the same key set in every locale. Prefer a base locale such as `app_zh.arb`; add a region-qualified catalog such as `app_zh_TW.arb` only when it has a distinct selectable translation.
- In widgets, read messages through `context.l10n`. In non-widget or background code, resolve the configured/system locale through the shared helpers in `lib/l10n/l10n.dart`; do not introduce a separate translation lookup mechanism.
- Translate message values only, and never rename variables such as `{count}` or `{name}`. In a message like `{count, plural, =1{1 file} other{{count} files}}`, translate the user-visible branch text while keeping `count`, `plural`, branch selectors such as `=1`/`other`, and the braces valid. Preserve the corresponding ARB placeholder metadata, and do not translate metadata keys prefixed with `@`.
- Prefer parameterized messages over string concatenation when word order can vary by language. Give placeholders explicit metadata and Dart types in the English ARB when appropriate.
- Do not edit generated `app_localizations*.dart` files. Regenerate them from ARB sources with `flutter gen-l10n`.
- Language names in the locale selector should remain native autonyms. Protocol names, product names, URLs, version strings, and dynamic data do not need translation unless they form part of natural-language copy.
- Design for longer translations and right-to-left locales: avoid fixed text widths, use flexible/wrapping layouts where needed, and do not encode direction with left/right-only assumptions.
- Do not hard-code production UI copy directly in widgets. Prototype-only text must be localized before the feature is considered complete.
- Before completing localization work, run from `ui/flutter`:

```sh
dart run ../../.github/workflows/scripts/check_l10n.dart
flutter gen-l10n
flutter analyze
flutter test
```

## 10) Quality Gate

Before merging major UI work:

- Verify desktop and mobile responsive behavior.
- Verify alignment and spacing consistency with shared tokens.
- Verify widget decomposition follows shared versus feature-local rules.
- Verify no obvious style duplication remains in page files where shared components are appropriate.
- Verify desktop window chrome behavior is correct for the target platform.
- Verify screens that exist in `design/` still match the intended layout and motion behavior.

name: test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "bind/**"
      - "cmd/**"
      - "internal/**"
      - "pkg/**"
      - "ui/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test.yml"
      - "go.mod"
      - "go.sum"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "bind/**"
      - "cmd/**"
      - "internal/**"
      - "pkg/**"
      - "ui/**"
      - ".github/workflows/test.yml"
      - "go.mod"
      - "go.sum"
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  GO_VERSION: "1.25.4"
  FLUTTER_VERSION: "3.41.6"

jobs:
  #  lint:
  #    name: Lint
  #    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  #    steps:
  #      - uses: actions/setup-go@v2
  #        with:
  #          go-version: '^1.19'
  #      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
  #      - name: Lint Go Code
  #        run: |
  #          export PATH=$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin # temporary fix. See https://github.com/actions/setup-go/issues/14
  #          go get -u golang.org/x/lint/golint
  #          golint -set_exit_status ./...
  test:
    name: Test check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}
      - name: Install webview dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -y
          sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev xvfb
      - name: Run Unit tests.
        run: |
          # Get packages for testing and coverage (including cmd/web for flags_test.go)
          PACKAGES=$(go list ./... | awk '!/\/bind\// && (!/\/cmd\// || /\/cmd\/web$/)')
          env CGO_ENABLED=1 xvfb-run -a go test -tags webview -v -coverpkg=$(echo "$PACKAGES" | paste -sd "," -) -covermode=count -coverprofile=coverage.txt $PACKAGES
          # Filter out main.go from coverage report to avoid lowering coverage percentage
          grep -v "main.go" coverage.txt > coverage_filtered.txt || true
          mv coverage_filtered.txt coverage.txt
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          files: ./coverage.txt
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_UPLOAD_TOKEN }}
  test-flutter-category:
    # The settings editor and the backend have to read an extension list the
    # same way, so both sides run the shared rule table. The Go side is covered
    # by the test job above, this runs the ui side of it.
    name: Test shared category rules
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: ${{ env.FLUTTER_VERSION }}
      - name: Run the shared category rule table on the ui side
        working-directory: ui/flutter
        run: |
          flutter pub get
          flutter gen-l10n
          flutter test test/api/downloader_config_test.dart
  test-flutter-task-context-menu:
    name: Test task context menus and text inputs

+
+Use `AppRouter.openWindow(AppWindowPayload)` for child-window destinations.

+preferred size can be supplied per destination. Keep backend and storage access
+on the existing capability API in either presentation.

+hosted in-app. Cancellation pops only the child surface. Completion selects the
+downloading list and returns home. The route payload uses a serializable string
+so browser history can restore a modal and its initial request.

# 测试体系与 CI

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说出 Gopeed 各层测试（协议级、下载器级、服务层、REST 层、webview 集成、Flutter 窗口级）分别放在哪里、怎么组织、用什么测试替身。
2. 理解 `internal/test` 的 HTTP 假服务器家族——每台「坏服务器」模拟哪一种线上故障。
3. 读懂上一轮提交（1e36599）新增的约 1100 行批量/分组任务测试：它们如何用内存协议、存储装饰器和通道同步复现竞态与故障。
4. 读懂本轮提交（cd19772）新增的三个 BT 共享客户端竞态回归测试：它们复现哪类「构建与关闭」竞态、修复后的锁窗口如何消除它。
5. 了解 d69874e/b0d4522 两个 Flutter 提交配套的窗口导航测试与能力生命周期测试的组织方式。
6. 会用 `cmd/extmock` 在不启动 Flutter UI 的情况下调试扩展。
7. 能在本地复现 CI 的测试命令，理解 `-tags webview`、`xvfb-run`、`-coverpkg` 与多 OS 矩阵各自解决什么问题。

## 2. 前置知识

- **测试替身（test double）**：真实网络、真实磁盘、真实浏览器在测试里既慢又不可复现。替身是用受控实现替换真实依赖的艺术：假 HTTP 服务器（替网络）、内存 Fetcher（替协议）、存储装饰器（替磁盘故障）、mock MethodChannel 与能力注册表（替 Flutter 的原生窗口与 Go 后端）、无头 WebView（替浏览器）。
- **表驱动测试**：Go 惯用法，把「输入 + 期望输出」列成结构体切片循环执行，一个函数覆盖十几种边界。本讲的分组目录白名单测试就是典型。
- **白盒测试**：`pkg/download/downloader_test.go`、`internal/protocol/bt/fetcher_test.go` 与被测代码在**同一个包**里，测试可以直接访问私有字段与包级变量（如 `d.groups`、`d.waitTasks`、BT 的 `lock`/`client`/`closeClient`），这是它能精确断言内部状态的原因。
- **通道同步（channel synchronization）**：要测试「删除进行到一半时另一个删除并发到达」这类竞态，测试用 `entered`/`release` 一对通道把被测代码精确卡在临界区中间，比 `time.Sleep` 可靠得多。BT 竞态测试则换一种手法：**用循环重复制造线程交叠窗口**（100 次初始化即关闭、两协程各 10 轮解析+关闭），配合 `go test -race` 的竞争检测器暴露数据竞争。
- **竞态回归测试（race regression test）**：修复并发 bug 后，写一个「反复制造交叠窗口」的测试钉住它。它不追求确定性复现某次交错，而是靠高频率重复让坏时序大概率出现；再以 `-race` 在检测到数据竞争时直接失败。
- **build tags 与 xvfb**：`-tags webview` 会编译依赖 WebKit/GTK 的真实 WebView 代码（需要 CGO）；`xvfb-run` 在无显示器的 CI 机器上提供虚拟 X 显示。二者配合才能在 Linux 云端跑浏览器级测试。
- 前置讲义：u3-l4（自定义协议 Fetcher，本讲综合实践为它补测试）、u4-l2（任务主链路）、u4-l6（TaskGroup 与批量创建，分组测试的主角）、u6-l1（BT 共享客户端设计，竞态测试的主角）。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 internal/test 辅助：可控的 HTTP 假服务器

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

HTTP 下载器的绝大多数 bug 都发生在「服务器行为不理想」时：Range 被忽略、重定向过期、Cookie 中途失效、连接数被限……这些场景没法靠一个正常服务器测出来。`internal/test/httptest.go` 的思路是：**每一种线上故障，造一台专门的假服务器**。它放在 `internal/` 下，意味着只有本项目测试能引用，不对外承诺 API 稳定。

所有服务器共享一份测试资产：常量 `BuildName`/`BuildSize`（200MB 的 `build.data`），见 [internal/test/httptest.go:L24-L43](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/internal/test/httptest.go#L24-L43)。注意 `BuildSize = 200 * 1024 * 1024`——每启动一台服务器都会生成一个 200MB 随机文件，这是完整测试套件较重的原因之一。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一台假服务器的生命周期：

```text
StartTestXxxServer()
  ├─ net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")     ← 随机端口，杜绝端口冲突
  ├─ 生成 200MB 随机 BuildFile             ← 数据随机，防「碰巧对齐」
  ├─ go server.Serve(listener)            ← 后台服务
  └─ 返回 shutdownListener
测试体：用 "http://<addr>/build.data" 下载、断言
listener.Close()
  ├─ server.Shutdown() 等待在途请求
  ├─ isShutdown = true（让慢速拷贝循环退出）
  └─ 删除 build.data / download.data / 重命名产物
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**公共底座 `startTestServer`**：随机端口 + 随机数据 + 自清理，见 [internal/test/httptest.go:L836-L871](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/internal/test/httptest.go#L836-L871)。`shutdownListener.Close()` 先优雅关停再删三个产物文件，保证测试之间互不污染（[internal/test/httptest.go:L879-L893](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/internal/test/httptest.go#L879-L893)）。

**Range 请求处理核心 `rangeFileHandle`**：手工解析 `Range: bytes=start-end`、Seek 到起点、设置 `Content-Range`/`Content-Length` 并返回 206，见 [internal/test/httptest.go:L705-L779](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/internal/test/httptest.go#L705-L779)。它的 `modifyEnd` 钩子允许服务器「故意多给数据」——`StartTestRangeBugServer` 用它制造 `Range: bytes=0-100` 却返回 150 字节的违规响应（[internal/test/httptest.go:L679-L703](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/internal/test/httptest.go#L679-L703)），正好对应 u5-l3 讲过的 Range 完整性校验。

**坏服务器家族速查表**（都在 [internal/test/httptest.go](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/internal/test/httptest.go) 中）：

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：亲眼看到假服务器的「启动—服务—自清理」闭环。
2. **操作步骤**：运行只依赖文件服务器的单个测试，并用 `-v` 观察输出：
   ```bash
   go test -v -run 'TestDownloader_CreateDirectBatch$' ./pkg/download/
   ```
   然后运行 `TestDownloader_Resolve`（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L241-L272](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L241-L272)），它在 `StartTestCustomServer` 上请求 `disposition`、`gbk-encoded` 等端点。
3. **需要观察的现象**：测试期间工作目录出现 `build.data`（约 200MB）与下载产物，测试结束后二者均被 `Close()` 删除；`-v` 下每个子测试名（表驱动的 `name` 字段）逐条打印。
4. **预期结果**：全部 PASS，目录干净。若中途 Ctrl+C 强杀，残留的 `build.data` 需要手动删除——这正是 `Close()` 承担清理职责的原因。
5. 以上命令为标准 `go test` 用法，可本地直接验证。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `StartTestFailThenRecoverServer` 特意用 416 而不是 500 来制造「可计数的失败」？
**答案**：u5-l3 讲过 HTTP Fetcher 的重试规则——5xx 与 429 豁免于失败计数（会无限重试），而 416 会计入失败上限。要测试「失败 N 次后 `Start()` 重试成功」，必须用会被计数的错误码，否则重试永远不会停止、测试永不返回。

**练习 2**：`rangeFileHandle` 的 `modifyEnd` 参数解决了什么测试难题？
**答案**：让服务器「合法地违反协议」——响应头声称 `Content-Range: 0-100/…` 却实际多写 50 字节。不修改 `Content-Length` 只多给数据，正好构造出「响应体比声明长」的违规样本，用来验证客户端会拒绝而非默默截断。

**练习 3**：`AssertResourceEqual` 为什么要先把 `got.Files[0].Ctime` 置 nil 再比较？
**答案**：`Ctime` 是 Resolve 时刻的当前时间，每次运行都不同；不剥离的话 `reflect.DeepEqual` 必然失败。这是「剥离不稳定字段后再深比较」的常见手法。

### 4.2 批量与分组任务测试：测试替身与新测试精读

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

假 HTTP 服务器替的是**网络**，但很多下载器行为（排队、分组、删除恢复、竞态）根本不需要走网络——它们需要一个**假协议**。`generationTestManager` 就是注册进 Downloader 的最小 FetcherManager（u3-l4 的 `mock://` 协议正是参考它实现的）。上一轮提交（1e36599）在 `pkg/download/downloader_test.go` 新增了 28 个测试函数、约 1100 行，全部建立在这套替身之上，覆盖 u4-l6 讲过的 TaskGroup 分组与 `CreateDirectBatchWithResult` 批量语义。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

分组批量测试的三层替身：

```text
第一层：generationTestManager（假协议）
  ├─ holdOpen=true   → Start() 后任务永远停在 running，便于断言队列
  ├─ resolveStarted/resolveRelease、pauseStarted/pauseRelease
  │     → 用通道把 Resolve/Pause 精确卡住，制造竞态窗口
  └─ starts/pauses 原子计数器 → 断言 Start/Pause 被调了几次

第二层：taskGroupTestStorage（存储装饰器）
  ├─ 嵌入真实 Storage，仅拦截 Put/Delete
  ├─ beforePut(task) 钩子 → 记录首次落盘 / 注入子任务写失败
  └─ failGroupPut / failGroupDelete → 让 task_group 桶读写失败

第三层：groupFailureConcurrentDeleteStorage（并发卡点装饰器）
  └─ Delete 命中 blockedID 时 close(entered) 并阻塞等 release
        → 测试主协程据此在「删除进行到一半」时发起第二个操作
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**① `generationTestManager`/`generationTestFetcher`：内存协议**。管理器只按 `generation://` 前缀匹配（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L110-L126](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L110-L126)）；Fetcher 的 `Resolve` 返回 1 字节单文件资源、`Start` 在 `holdOpen=false` 时立刻向 `done` 通道发 nil（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L128-L161](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L128-L161)）。配套的 `recoveryTestManager` 补上 `Store`/`Restore`，专门服务断点恢复类测试（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L191-L217](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L191-L217)）。

**② 分组测试脚手架**。`newTaskGroupDownloader` 一步造出「单协议 + 内存存储 + holdOpen」的 Downloader，并直接改写私有字段 `d.cfg.MaxRunning`（白盒优势），见 [pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4048-L4060](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4048-L4060)；`taskGroupBatch` 生成 `Group:true, GroupName:"folder"` 加 N 个 `generation://file/i` 成员的批量请求（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4062-L4068](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4062-L4068)）。

**③ 存储装饰器**。`taskGroupTestStorage` 嵌入 `Storage` 接口，按桶名拦截：`failGroupPut` 让 `task_group` 桶写入失败，`beforePut` 让普通任务落盘前注入错误（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4161-L4184](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4161-L4184)）。有了它，`TestDownloader_TaskGroupPartialFailureAndFirstSave` 才能让 3 个成员中间那个写盘失败、验证「部分成功」——批量为 3 只建成 2 个，且**首次落盘就带 ParentID**（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4186-L4224](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4186-L4224)）。

**④ 分组元数据与重启恢复**。`TestDownloader_TaskGroupMetadataAndRestore` 用真 `BoltStorage` 验证三件事：组不是任务（`GetTask(parentID) == nil`）；成员任务的 JSON 序列化含 `"group":` 但不含 `"type":`（组不会混进任务列表）；`Close()` 后重开同目录，`task.group` 指针被 Setup 重新挂接、删除组 ID 连带清空 `d.groups`（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4070-L4110](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4070-L4110)）。这正对应 u4-l6 讲的「ParentID 落盘为权威、group 指针为运行时缓存」双轨制。

**⑤ 队列与按组操作**。`TestDownloader_TaskGroupQueue` 以 `MaxRunning=5` 提交 6 成员批（叠加 0/2 个既有任务），断言 `running=5-existing`、`waiting=1+existing`；再按「组 ID + 成员 ID」暂停，验证全部成员进入 pause 且 `d.waitTasks` 清空、`expandGroupTaskIDs` 去重后仍为 6（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4112-L4159](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4112-L4159)）。

**⑥ 删除失败的持久化恢复**（u4-l4 讲义核心机制的测试证据）：

- `TestDownloader_TaskGroupDeletePersistence`：删除成员失败后，任务**必须仍在内存**且**必须仍在 `bucketTask` 桶里**——测试直接 `storage.Get(bucketTask, …)` 验证落盘恢复（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4367-L4385](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4367-L4385)）。
- `TestDownloader_TaskGroupConcurrentDelete`：用 `entered`/`release` 通道把成员 A 的删除卡在存储层，此刻删掉成员 B——断言组元数据**不被并发清理误删**（[pkg/download/downloader_test.go:L4387-L4426](https://github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/blob/d69874e13eddd0dcaa77f2f5dd307e44346ab9e3/pkg/download/downloader_test.go#L4387-L4426)）。
